description: Save a scenario file in the simulation workspace this credential is connected to, under a name, to run or revise later (list_saved_simulation_scenarios and get_saved_simulation_scenario read it back, delete_saved_simulation_scenario removes it). Takes the file's JSON text, for example the scenario draft_simulation_scenario returned; a draft with problems is saved as it stands and the problems are reported. The file's own name is set to the saved name. A name already saved is refused (CONFLICT) unless replace=true, which saves over it. Saved scenarios outlive reset_simulation_workspace and snapshot restores; a workspace keeps up to 100. Refused on any account that is not a simulation workspace (NOT_A_SIMULATION_WORKSPACE).

name.description: The name to save it under, unique in the workspace ignoring case (at most 100 characters).

replace.description: Optional, default false. True saves over a scenario already saved under this name.

scenario.description: The whole scenario file as JSON text (format "spark.scenario", version 1).

name: save_simulation_scenario
title: Save Simulation Scenario
